name: Architectural Depot Lifecycle Program
platform: Klaviyo (email + SMS), fed by the Miva storefront

phases.label: Launch
phases.note: The revenue core: capture, recover, and look after first orders.

phases.label: Within 30 days
phases.note: Brand-specific levers: Depot Dollars, samples, pros, catalog triggers.

phases.label: Within 60 days
phases.note: Retention and list hygiene once there is enough history to segment.

rules.title: Flow priority
rules.text: When a profile qualifies for several flows, the higher one wins: Post-Purchase > Cart > Sample-to-Order > Depot Dollars > Back in Stock > Browse > Welcome / Pro > Win-Back > Sunset. Klaviyo removes a profile from a flow the moment it fails a flow filter, so "not in flow X" filters go only on the short, low-priority flows (Browse, Welcome, Win-Back, Sunset). The revenue flows (Cart, Post-Purchase, Sample, Depot Dollars) never block each other; Smart Sending spaces their messages.

rules.title: Email frequency
rules.text: Smart Sending at 16 hours on every marketing flow email, except Cart E1, Post-Purchase E1 and the back-in-stock alert, which always send. Campaigns respect the same window.

rules.title: SMS frequency
rules.text: Smart Sending at 24 hours. No profile gets more than 3 marketing texts in any rolling 7 days across flows and campaigns, and never more than 3 in 24 hours (Florida, Oklahoma and Maryland law).

rules.title: SMS quiet hours
rules.text: Texts send only from 10am to 8pm in the recipient's local time. A step that lands outside the window waits for the next one. Set Klaviyo quiet hours and use send windows on each SMS step.

rules.title: Discount guardrails
rules.text: The only standing discount is the welcome offer, if confirmed. Cart recovery and win-back use bonus Depot Dollars before any percentage off. No automated percentage-off on made-to-order items.

rules.title: Made-to-order honesty
rules.text: Whenever a made-to-order item can appear, say plainly that it is built to the customer's specs, cannot be returned, and that measurements are worth a second check. Frame it as craftsmanship, never as a warning label.

rules.title: Exits
rules.text: Every pre-purchase flow exits on Placed Order. Sample-to-Order exits on any non-sample order.

rules.title: Tracking
rules.text: Every link carries utm_source=klaviyo, utm_medium=email or sms, utm_campaign=<flow id>, utm_content=<message id>. Turn off Klaviyo's automatic UTM parameters for these flows so they are not doubled.

rules.title: Consent by country
rules.text: US buyers who never subscribed can receive cart and post-purchase email under CAN-SPAM. Canadian buyers need express consent (CASL): add a flow filter "Country is not Canada OR email consent is subscribed" to Cart, Browse and Post-Purchase.

segments.name: Engaged 90d (email)
segments.definition: Clicked email OR active on site in the last 90 days, OR subscribed in the last 30 days. Default audience for campaigns.

segments.name: Pros
segments.definition: customer_type is contractor, builder, designer or architect.

segments.name: Sample buyers, no full order
segments.definition: Placed Order where all items are samples at least once, and zero non-sample orders.

segments.name: Lapsed customers
segments.definition: Placed Order at least once, last order 180+ days ago (pros 120+), no site activity in 60 days. Triggers Win-Back.

segments.name: Unengaged 120d
segments.definition: No email clicks and no site activity in 120 days, and received at least 8 emails in that window. Opens are ignored because Apple Mail Privacy Protection inflates them. Triggers Sunset.

segments.name: Sunset (suppressed)
segments.definition: email_sunset is true. Exclude from every campaign send.

segments.name: SMS subscribers
segments.definition: Can receive SMS marketing. Exclude anyone texted 3 times in the last 7 days from SMS campaigns.

data_requirements.item: Viewed Product, Added to Cart, Started Checkout, Placed Order, Ordered Product events
data_requirements.why: Triggers and dynamic blocks for Browse, Cart and Post-Purchase. Confirm the Miva integration sends Started Checkout; if not, Cart triggers on Added to Cart.

data_requirements.item: Item properties: SKU, product name, category, image URL, price, made_to_order flag
data_requirements.why: Branching on made-to-order items, sample detection (SKU contains SAMPLE), category-based tips and cross-sells.
data_requirements.status: Confirm made_to_order flag exists or derive it from category/SKU.

data_requirements.why: /BASK.html only restores a cart on the same browser. A restore link is needed for cross-device recovery.
Depot Dollars Expiring flow. Fallback: trigger on Placed Order + 76 days without a balance.
data_requirements.status: Needs a Miva to Klaviyo sync

data_requirements.why: Pro flow. Set by a popup question, the pro form, or the Welcome E3 link.
Back in Stock and Price Drop triggers and product recommendation blocks.
Welcome offer. Generate a code list in Miva and upload it to a Klaviyo coupon.

to_confirm.question: Is there a signup offer, and what is it? Public sources disagree on whether 10% off the first order is live.
Unique codes per subscriber (uploaded list) or one shared code? Exclusions (made-to-order, sale items)?
Can cart recovery offer bonus Depot Dollars (e.g. double, 10% back) on the third touch? Or no incentive at all?
What can a lapsed customer be offered?
What production time should automated emails quote for made-to-order items, by line?
to_confirm.default: Leave as a placeholder until confirmed

to_confirm.question: Is the cost of a sample credited toward a full order?
Is there trade pricing or a pro account program?
Which real team member signs the high-value cart note and takes those calls?
Which social handle should customers tag?
Swap the template's placeholder colors and wordmark for the real logo and brand colors.
Toll-free number or short code? Who owns the toll-free verification?
